newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tsogo Sun wins Mpumalanga casino licence.
newsitem.headline: Tsogo Sun wins Mpumalanga casino licence.

text.p: Tsogo Sun Holdings (Pty) Ltd has won a casino licence for the Nelspruit-area in South Africa's eastern Mpumalanga province.
Tsogo is a joint-venture between a black consortium and South African Breweries hotels unit Southern Sun.

"After careful consideration... the board was convinced that the project proposed by Tsogo Sun meets the requirements of the board and will be in the best interest of the province and specifically the people of the Lowveld," the Gaming Board said.

It said it took the decision after considering aspects including the financial strength, the operating and development experience of the applicant, the quality of the development design and overall concept and the extent to which provision is made for local participation and entrepreneurial development.
Earlier this month Tsogo won its first casino licence in the Highveld area of the province.
